rationale: Watkins explicitly wants to stay and Villa refuse to sell ('He has been clear with Unai Emery', Football Insider 4 Aug; Fenerbahce turned to Guirassy, 2 Aug); Newcastle/Man Utd interest is only exploratory and Villa rested Watkins for the Super Cup as a squad player.
Arsenal rejected at £40m for £60m-rated Konsa with deal '99% done' per Football Insider (14 Aug) but Fabrizio Romano on 15 Aug says no agreement — Villa holding firm at £60m.
Club-level agreement advancing between City and Spurs (£65m+add-ons / £85m package) with player pushing out and personal terms agreed; 'Savinho to join Tottenham next week' (Eyefootball, 15 Aug).

Man Utd not proceeding due to Baleba's ankle ligament injury (Romano, 8 Aug); Newcastle interest per Mail/talkSPORT (15 Aug) but only 'talk in the north east' of £65m and Brighton are tough negotiators.
Maresca coy but Marmoush scored twice and said he's enjoying City (9 Aug); Spurs and Newcastle leading contenders and he may be sold only if City land midfielders (Ben Jacobs, 14 Aug).
City in negotiations with Lille (Telegraph via BBC gossip, 15 Aug) with personal terms agreed (Plettenberg, 3 Aug) at ~€90-100m; Lille coach Ancelotti still hopes he stays.
Palmeiras insist Allan is 'not for sale', rejecting €30m from Villa and €35m from Napoli and demanding €45m+ (Hernan/Goal/ESPN, 4-10 Aug); Villa remain the most persistent bidder.

Romano reported a verbal agreement between Young Boys and Como on 12 Jul with personal terms agreed, but no official announcement appeared by 15 Aug, raising doubt about it closing before the 1 Sep deadline.
Villa in direct talks with Chelsea for a permanent deal (£60-65m) and Jackson has said yes to Emery (Schira, 13 Aug), with Tottenham and Atletico also interested (RMC via BBC gossip, 15 Aug).
Liverpool have a verbal agreement with Barcola and PSG are ready to drop their asking price while adding Torres and Godts (Romano/Sports Mole, 14-15 Aug), but the ~€150m gap keeps the deal alive.
Martinez told Villa he wants Juventus and Juve have revived talks (Di Marzio/talkSPORT, 15 Aug), but this hinges on Villa signing Suzuki and Juve weighing alternatives such as Vicario and Ederson.
Chelsea's £120m deadline passed with no bids and ESPN (14 Aug) reports Chelsea expect Enzo to stay, though City remain the only realistic buyer.
Martinelli rejected Galatasaray's €45m bid (Ornstein/Romano, 14 Aug) and PSG moved on to other targets (BBC, 13 Aug); Bayern interest noted since June, while Martinelli wants to stay at the Emirates.
Fabinho left Al-Ittihad as a free agent on 6 Aug and prioritizes a return to Europe, with MLS and Asia also open (ESPN, 7-8 Aug); his next club is unknown and a return to Brazil is unlikely.
